description: Adding the fact \(p\) to the two-rule cycle gives stages \(\varnothing\), \(\{p\}\), \(\{p,q\}\), and least model \(\{p,q\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.cycle_with_fact :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.seededCycle 0 = ∅ ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.seededCycle 1 =
        {Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p} ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.stage Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.seededCycle 2 =
          {Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.q} ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.seededCycle =
            {Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.q} ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.seededCycle
            ↑{Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.q}
